spans.s: (III)--a son of वसिष्ठ and a प्रजापति of the स्वारोचिष epoch.
(V)--one of the twenty Sutapa गणस्. वा. १००. १४.
(VI)--a sage of the तामस epoch. Vi.

--reckoning and research in astronomy with the help of the शास्त्रस्, experience, observation, and comparison; physical eyes, science, waters, writing and counting are essential instru- ments in this science. Br. II. २४. १५२; वा. ५३. १२३. [page१-656+ ३३]
--one of the seven sages of तामस epoch; a भार्गव. भा.

3: भा.
--a peak of Meru full of precious stones; here आदित्यस्, Vasus, अश्विन्स्, Guhyakas, यक्षस्, other sages, Apsaras, all worship पशुपति besides Nandi and गन्गा. वा. ३०. ८१-92.
(I)--a boundary hill in प्लक्षद्वीप. भा. V. २०. 4.
(II)--one of the ten sons of Kardama and king of कुशद्वीप which he divided among his seven sons, Udbhijja, वेणुमान्, Vairatha, लवण, धृति, प्रभाकर and Kapila. Br. II. १४. 9, २७-28.
(III)--a name in the first Marut गण. Br.
(IV)--(भार्गव) a sage of the Rohita epoch. Br.
(V)--one of the ten sons of स्वायम्भुव Manu.
(VI)--a grandson of स्वायम्भुव Manu; consecrated for कुशद्वीप. वा. ३१. १८; ३३. 9, १२.
(VII)--a son of Priyavrata and king of कुश- द्वीप. Vi.
--R. a tributary of the सरस्वती, flows from Varcovan lake. Br. II. १८. ६६. M. १२१. ६५; वा. ४७. ६३.
--a देवगण with Yama as their lord; Vasus. Br.
(I)--a R. from the सरयू (or मानस?). Br. II. १८. ७१.
(II)--a कल of the moon. Br. IV. ३५. ९२.
(III)--a तनु of प्रजापति; men created from it were all delightful beings; of सत्व quality. वा. 9. २०; Br.
--a शक्ति on the सोडश patra1bja. Br. IV. ३२. ११. [page१-658+ २९]
